Identified that Qwen3.5-0.8B suffers from repetitive backtracking and overthinking loops during mathematical reasoning (entering endless cycles of 'Wait, let me double check...', 'Wait, this grouping was wrong...', etc.), causing long generations to exhaust token limits without concluding.

Traced this behaviour in weight space to a small cluster of specific 'wait/hesitation' neurons in the late MLP layers (specifically L22.573, L18.881, L17.1915, L20.405, and L23 neurons) that write strongly along the unembedding direction for hesitation tokens (e.g., ' Wait').

Using `wsp.edit.orthogonalize_out`, surgically projected out the 'wait' direction from what these specific MLP down-projection columns write to the residual stream (changing only 6,124 weights, 0.0008% of the model). This completely eliminates the self-doubt / backtracking loops on math problems, allowing the model to finish its reasoning and produce correct boxed answers, while preserving performance and instruction-following on unrelated tasks.
